shared_elements: low-relief carving with figures raised against a flat ground
animal or bird form in profile
band of repeated small elements running horizontally
arm/hand and leg elements rendered along the shaft/edge of the figure
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief with a stylised plant/branch of paired leaves and a horizontal register of repeated small motifs, and both include creature forms in profile, but these are generic correspondences. A depicts a single large anthropomorphic winged figure with a bucket and staff dominating the field beside a flowering plant, whereas B shows a pillar-like form crowded with schematic quadrupeds, birds and a row of crouching animals in tiers, with wholly different proportions and no human figure.
